name: set_ambiance
description: Set the on-screen mood/lighting theme to match the vibe. Use it when the guest asks for a vibe or when a drink suggests one — e.g. switch to "tiki" for tropical/rum drinks, "speakeasy" for classic/dark, or "bright" for fresh daytime drinks. Does not return anything.

mode.description: One of: "speakeasy" (warm, low-lit, classic), "tiki" (tropical teal and orange), or "bright" (clean, well-lit, daytime).
